games.name: Minigolf
games.howTo: Take turns. Pull back anywhere in your half (or by your ball) and let go. The course turns to face whoever is shooting.
games.handicap: Longer aim guide, and strokes off the score

games.name: Air Hockey
games.howTo: Drag your paddle around your half and hit the puck into the far goal.
games.handicap: Bigger paddle, wider goal to shoot at

games.name: Sumo
games.blurb: Push the other wrestler out. Best of 3.
games.howTo: Your wrestler turns slowly. Hold your button to charge, let go to dash.

games.name: Ping Pong
games.howTo: Slide your paddle along your end. Where the ball hits sets the angle.
games.handicap: Bigger paddle, slower ball toward you

games.name: Penalty Shootout
games.blurb: Five kicks each, then sudden death.
games.howTo: Shooter swipes to kick. Keeper taps left, middle or right to dive.

games.name: Snack Snatch
games.howTo: Tap your button to snap your critter's jaws at the snacks.

games.name: Snake Duel
games.howTo: Tap your left or right button to turn.
games.handicap: Slower snake, turn assist near walls

games.name: Quick Draw
games.blurb: Tap first on DRAW! Best of 5.
games.howTo: Wait for DRAW! and tap. Tapping early, or on a fake-out, loses the round.
games.handicap: Opponent's tap counts a little later

games.name: Tank Duel
games.howTo: Drag your stick to drive, tap fire. Shots bounce off walls.

games.name: Sea Battle
games.howTo: Hide your fleet, pass the phone, then take turns firing at the enemy grid.

games.name: Four in a Row
games.blurb: Four in a line. Best of 3.
games.howTo: Tap a column to drop a disc.
games.handicap: Hint glow on winning and blocking moves

games.name: Checkers
games.howTo: Tap a piece, then where it goes. Captures are compulsory.

games.name: Chop Chop
games.blurb: Last one chopping, or first to 50.
games.howTo: Tap left or right of your tree to chop. Dodge the branches.

games.name: Rock Paper Scissors
games.howTo: Both pick in secret, then reveal.
